tooltips.JContrast: Set the H-K contrast response at this tonal anchor. Positive values darken below J Center and brighten above it.
tooltips.CContrast: Set the ordered chroma contrast response at this tonal anchor. Positive values reduce chroma below C Center and increase it above.
tooltips.jSaturationCenter: Set the saturation center where the J contrast response crosses zero.
tooltips.jSaturationWidth: Set the width of the J contrast transition around its center.
tooltips.cSaturationCenter: Set the saturation center where the C contrast response crosses zero.
tooltips.cSaturationWidth: Set the width of the C contrast transition around its center.

tooltips.JContrast: 设置此色调锚点的 H-K 对比响应。正值降低明度中心以下的明度并提高其以上的明度。
tooltips.CContrast: 设置此色调锚点的有序彩度对比响应。正值降低彩度中心以下的彩度并提高其以上的彩度。
tooltips.jSaturationCenter: 设置 J 对比响应变为零的饱和度中心。
tooltips.jSaturationWidth: 设置 J 对比中心周围的过渡宽度。
tooltips.cSaturationCenter: 设置 C 对比响应变为零的饱和度中心。
tooltips.cSaturationWidth: 设置 C 对比中心周围的过渡宽度。
